name: coding-iris-plugin
description: Reusable fast/full/guarded coding rules and workflows for IRIS ObjectScript, CSP, JavaScript, and HISUI projects.

projectDirectories.purpose: 已确认对象范围的 IRIS XML 部署包、离线增量/回退 XML 与逐项校验回执
projectDirectories.boundary: 只保存当前工程正式交付；服务器任务身份、私有计划与恢复状态归 ContextRoot/work/iris-xml-export
projectDirectories.lifecycle: 按任务创建并保留正式交付；不自动导入业务环境或清理历史附件

projectDirectories.purpose: XML 导出计划、离线编辑原包/对象与回执、服务器产物归属及恢复断点
projectDirectories.boundary: 私有状态受 Git 忽略；正式 XML 归 docs/delivery/iris-xml，不能写共享 CapabilityRoot
projectDirectories.lifecycle: 按任务创建；未知结果核实前保留，不作为普通临时文件清理

projectDirectories.purpose: 项目按需导出的私有基线、现场保护与恢复断点
projectDirectories.boundary: 仅保存按需同步的私有现场与基线；业务源码归 SourceRoot，正式交付归 docs/delivery
projectDirectories.lifecycle: 按任务创建；按 source-sync 恢复与发布契约保留，不作为普通临时文件清理

defaultPrompt: 从已确认的 IRIS 环境导出准确对象范围的 XML 部署包
按版本 XML 范围采集指定实例当前代码基线并报告缺失
Initialize IRIS coding support in this project
Handle an IRIS coding request with the unified coding workflow

Modify this CSP/HISUI page using IRIS frontend rules
Look up an IRIS class, method signature, or official documentation page
Promote a committed demand from a DEV on-demand-export repository into a PRD repository after refreshing the PRD server baseline
Handle an explicitly identified legacy GB2312 frontend project after confirmation
Prepare an IRIS deployment manifest and deploy after confirmation
Check this change against IRIS coding and deployment rules
